items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was with Milt Trenier... I had mentioned that I had been out with Milt Trenier for about four years.

ctx.x: Was it like the kind of thing where he was opening for you all?
No, he was – I was with Milt Trenier, and he was on the program.
Is Milt Trenier an organ player? What did he play?
